{{Top|leg}}
'''Farrann''' was a commentator on [[Gundark's Gear Datalog]] during the early [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Commenting on the entry for the [[QuickMed]] [[med-aid]], Farrann noted that despite their age, the kits were common in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. Farrann warned that some of the contents, such as [[Painkiller/Legends|pain killers]] and [[Anti-venom ampule|anti-venom]], were hundreds of [[Standard year/Legends|years]] out of date and were probably either ineffective or possibly toxic.<ref name="GFT">''[[Gundark's Fantastic Technology: Personal Gear]]''</ref>
